NORMAL.action: Leave at 22:30 via the canopy walk to Gate B, then Flinders St.
NORMAL.reason: Gate A is full, so you're sent to Gate B. The canopy walk is covered and you still reach platform 6 for the 23:07 Sandringham train.
NORMAL.text_localised: 22:30 走加顶棚步道（经小吃车）到 B 门，再步行到 Flinders St，6 号站台搭 23:07 桑德灵厄姆线。
NORMAL.reason_localised: A 门人满，改走 B 门。路线有顶棚，时间仍赶得上 23:07 的车。与朋友走散就在 B 门外 2 号接送区会合。

alternatives.action: Take the covered path to Gate C, then the underpass to Flinders St.
alternatives.reason: Shorter covered walk and an underpass straight to the station, but Gate C is busier tonight.
alternatives.text_localised: 走有顶棚的步道到 C 门，再经地下通道到 Flinders St，6 号站台 23:07 上车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 全程有顶棚、路更短；但 C 门人较多。走散就在 C 门咨询帐篷等。

alternatives.action: Take the lawn path to Gate B, then walk to Flinders St.
alternatives.reason: Two minutes quicker to the same gate, but the lawn path has no cover.
alternatives.text_localised: 走草坪步道到 B 门，再步行到 Flinders St，6 号站台 23:07 上车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 更快两分钟，但这条路没有顶棚。会合点：B 门外 2 号接送区。

alternatives.action: Go via Gate C to the coach bays for the 23:30 shuttle.

transport.line: General shuttle 23:30 (to Southern Cross, from Flinders St coach bays)

alternatives.reason: If you miss the train, this covered route reaches the 23:30 shuttle to Southern Cross.
alternatives.text_localised: 经有顶棚步道到 C 门，走地下通道到长途车位，搭 23:30 班车去南十字。
alternatives.reason_localised: 若赶不上火车，这是备选；全程有顶棚。会合点：C 门咨询帐篷。

NORMAL.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的咨询帐篷，或把这个屏幕给任何一位志愿者看。

STORM.action: Leave now at 22:30 via the covered path to Gate C, then the covered underpass to Flinders Street.
STORM.reason: Gate C keeps you under cover all the way to the station before the 23:00 storm; you wait inside for the 23:07 Sandringham train on platform 6. Meet your friends at the Gate C info tent first.
STORM.text_localised: 22:30 出发，走有顶棚的通道到 C 门，再走有顶的地下通道到弗林德斯街车站。
STORM.reason_localised: 全程有遮挡，23:00 暴雨前可到站内；在站内等 23:07 Sandringham 线、6 号站台。先在 C 门信息亭与朋友会合。

alternatives.action: If you miss the train, take the covered path to Gate C and catch the 23:30 shuttle from the coach bays.

transport.line: General shuttle 23:30 (to Southern Cross, from Flinders St coach bays)

alternatives.reason: Same covered route; the coach bays are covered, so you can wait there safely during the storm, but it goes to Southern Cross, not Sandringham.
alternatives.text_localised: 若赶不上火车，仍走 C 门有顶通道，到大巴站乘 23:30 班车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 路线同样有顶，大巴站可避雨；但只到南十字站，需再转车。

alternatives.action: Leave immediately via Gate C for the 22:50 shuttle at the coach bays.

transport.line: General shuttle 22:50 (to Southern Cross, from Flinders St coach bays)

alternatives.reason: Earliest way off site, but you must leave by 22:31 and it ends at Southern Cross, not your Sandringham line.
alternatives.text_localised: 立刻出发走 C 门，赶 22:50 大巴站班车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 最早离场，但必须 22:31 前出发，且只到南十字站。

STORM.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的信息亭，或把此屏幕出示给任何一位志愿者。
STORM.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s4.2 Severe weather (MOCK)

GATE_A.action: Wait in the quiet zone, then leave at 23:00 via Gate C to platform 6
GATE_A.reason: Gate A is closed and Gate B is crowded. Waiting until 23:00 lets the crush pass; the covered path to Gate C still gets you the 23:27 Sandringham train from platform 6.
GATE_A.text_localised: 先在安静区休息，23:00 从 C 门有顶棚的通道出场，去 6 号站台坐 23:27 的 Sandringham 线列车。
GATE_A.reason_localised: A 门已关闭，附近的门很挤。等到 23:00 出发可以避开人流，仍能赶上 23:27 的列车。

alternatives.action: Leave at 23:00 via Gate B canopy walk for the 23:47 train
alternatives.reason: Covered walk to Gate B, but a longer uncovered walk to the station and a later train at 23:47.
alternatives.text_localised: 走有顶棚的树冠步道到 B 门，再步行到车站，坐 23:47 的列车，6 号站台。
alternatives.reason_localised: 路线有顶棚，但到车站一段没有遮挡，列车要等到 23:47。

alternatives.action: Leave at 23:00 via Gate C and take the 23:30 shuttle from the coach bays

transport.line: General shuttle 23:30 (to Southern Cross, from Flinders St coach bays)

alternatives.reason: Fully covered to the coach bays, but it goes to Southern Cross, not your Sandringham line.
alternatives.text_localised: 23:00 从 C 门走顶棚通道到长途巴士区，乘 23:30 的接驳车去南十字站。
alternatives.reason_localised: 全程有顶棚，但终点是南十字站，不是 Sandringham 线。

alternatives.action: Leave at 23:00 via Gate D ramp path for the 23:47 train
alternatives.reason: Quietest and step-free, but the longest walk and a later train at 23:47.
alternatives.text_localised: 23:00 走无台阶坡道到 D 门，再步行到车站，坐 23:47 的列车，6 号站台。
alternatives.reason_localised: 人最少、无台阶，但路程最长，列车要等到 23:47。

GATE_A.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的信息帐篷，或把这个屏幕给任何一位志愿者看。
GATE_A.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s5.1 Gate closure (MOCK)

TRAIN_SAND_25.action: Leave now via Gate C on the covered path to Flinders St, platform 6, 22:52 train.
TRAIN_SAND_25.reason: Sandringham trains are 25 min late, but Gate C's covered underpass is the shortest walk, so you still make the 22:52. Meet your friends at the Gate C info tent first — it saves phone battery.
TRAIN_SAND_25.text_localised: 现在就走：走有顶棚的小路到 C 门，再走地下通道到弗林德斯街车站，6 号站台 22:52 的车。
TRAIN_SAND_25.reason_localised: Sandringham 线延误 25 分钟。C 门路线最短且有顶棚，仍赶得上 22:52。先在 C 门咨询亭与同伴会合。

alternatives.action: Take the open riverside path to Gate A, then walk 12 min to Flinders St for the 22:52 train.
alternatives.reason: Same 22:52 train, no stairs, but a longer uncovered walk and a busier main gate.
alternatives.text_localised: 走河边开放步道到 A 门，再步行 12 分钟到车站，搭 6 号站台 22:52 的车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 同一班 22:52 的车，没有台阶，但路程更长且无遮挡，A 门人更多。

alternatives.action: Take the canopy walk to Gate B, then walk to Flinders St for the 23:12 train.
alternatives.reason: Covered start and a calmer pace if you need time to find your friends, but you wait for the 23:12 train.
alternatives.text_localised: 走食品车旁的有顶棚步道到 B 门，再步行到车站，搭 6 号站台 23:12 的车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 出发有遮挡、时间更宽裕，方便先找到同伴，但要等 23:12 的车。

alternatives.action: Walk to Gate A and take the 22:50 general shuttle to Southern Cross instead.
alternatives.reason: Avoids the delayed Sandringham line and has plenty of seats, but drops you at Southern Cross, not your usual station.
alternatives.text_localised: 走到 A 门，搭 22:50 的普通接驳车到南十字星站。
alternatives.reason_localised: 避开延误的 Sandringham 线，座位充足，但终点是南十字星站，需换乘。

TRAIN_SAND_25.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的信息帐篷，或把这个屏幕给任何一位志愿者看。
TRAIN_SAND_25.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s6.3 Public transport disruption (MOCK)

SHUTTLE_FULL.action: Leave now via Gate C on the covered path, then take the Sandringham train from platform 6 at 23:07.
SHUTTLE_FULL.reason: Covered path and covered underpass make this the shortest, clearest walk to the station; it has steps, which is fine for you. Meet your friends at the Gate C info tent so no one is lost near the food trucks.
SHUTTLE_FULL.text_localised: 现在从 Gate C 走有顶棚的通道，到 Flinders Street 站，坐 23:07 的 Sandringham 线，6 号站台。
SHUTTLE_FULL.reason_localised: 这条路全程有顶棚、最短最好找（有台阶）。先在 Gate C 问讯帐篷和朋友会合，避免走散。

alternatives.action: Leave via Gate A on the open riverside path, then catch the 23:07 Sandringham train from platform 6.
alternatives.reason: No steps and the simplest walk from River Stage, but the path is open to the sky and Gate A is the busiest exit.
alternatives.text_localised: 从 Gate A 走河边的路，到 Flinders Street 站，坐 23:07 的 Sandringham 线，6 号站台。
alternatives.reason_localised: 没有台阶、最好走，但没有顶棚，而且 Gate A 人最多。

alternatives.action: Take the canopy walk to Gate B, then walk 15 minutes to Flinders Street for the 23:07 train.
alternatives.reason: Covered inside the site but a long uncovered walk to the station; leave by 22:38 to make the 23:07 train.
alternatives.text_localised: 走有顶棚的小路到 Gate B，再步行 15 分钟到车站，坐 23:07 的列车，6 号站台。
alternatives.reason_localised: 园内有顶棚，但出园后要走很久；最晚 22:38 出发。路过美食车，和朋友一起走。

alternatives.action: Leave via Gate A and take the 23:30 general shuttle to Southern Cross.
alternatives.reason: Plenty of seats and a covered shelter to wait in, but it goes to Southern Cross, not your Sandringham line.
alternatives.text_localised: 从 Gate A 出去，坐 23:30 的普通接驳车去 Southern Cross。
alternatives.reason_localised: 座位多、候车处有顶棚，但终点是 Southern Cross，不是你的 Sandringham 线。

SHUTTLE_FULL.escalate_text_localised: 请到最近的问讯帐篷，或把这个屏幕给任何一位志愿者看。
SHUTTLE_FULL.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s7.4 Accessible transport (MOCK)

HEAT.action: Fill your bottle at the Tent Stage water point, then take the covered path to Gate C and get the 23:07 Sandringham train from platform 6.
HEAT.reason: In extreme heat this is the shadiest option: covered path, covered underpass, and water on the way. It has stairs, but you reach Flinders at 22:46 for the 23:07 train.
HEAT.text_localised: 先在帐篷舞台饮水点装水，走有遮挡的小路到 C 门，经地下通道到弗林德斯街站，6 号站台乘 23:07 Sandringham 线。
HEAT.reason_localised: 高温天，这条路全程有遮挡，还经过饮水点。有台阶，但 22:46 到站，可从容赶上 23:07 的车。与朋友在 C 门问询帐篷会合。

alternatives.action: Take the canopy walk past the food trucks to Gate B, then walk to Flinders Street for the 23:07 Sandringham train.
alternatives.reason: Shaded inside the site, but the 15-minute walk to the station is in the open heat.
alternatives.text_localised: 走小吃车旁的遮阳棚道到 B 门，再步行到弗林德斯街站，乘 23:07 的 Sandringham 线。
alternatives.reason_localised: 园内有遮挡，但去车站的 15 分钟路段没有遮阳，较热。

alternatives.action: Walk the open riverside path to Gate A and the 22:50 general shuttle to Southern Cross.
alternatives.reason: Shortest walk and a big air-conditioned shuttle, but the path is in the open sun-heat and it changes your route home.
alternatives.text_localised: 走河边开放小路到 A 门，乘 22:50 前往南十字站的接驳车（遮阳候车棚）。
alternatives.reason_localised: 路程最短、车位多，但路段无遮挡，且需换乘回家。

alternatives.action: Take the open riverside path to Gate A and walk to Flinders Street for the 23:07 Sandringham train.
alternatives.reason: Step-free and simple to follow, but no shade at all — only choose it if stairs are a problem.
alternatives.text_localised: 走河边开放小路到 A 门，再步行到弗林德斯街站，6 号站台乘 23:07 的车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 无台阶、路线简单，但全程没有遮挡，高温下较辛苦。

HEAT.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的问询帐篷，或把此屏幕出示给任何一位志愿者。
HEAT.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s4.4 Extreme heat (MOCK)

SET_RIVER_30.action: Leave now via Gate C on the covered path, then train at 23:27.
SET_RIVER_30.reason: Gate C is the shortest covered walk to Flinders St and still makes the 23:27 Sandringham train after the 30-minute set delay. Meet your friends at the Gate C info tent so nobody gets lost.
SET_RIVER_30.text_localised: 现在从 C 门走有顶棚的通道去弗林德斯街车站，乘 23:27 Sandringham 线，6 号站台。
SET_RIVER_30.reason_localised: 演出延后30分钟，这条路最短且有遮挡，仍赶得上23:27的车。先在C门咨询帐篷与朋友会合。

alternatives.action: Take the open riverside path to Gate A, then walk to Flinders St for the 23:27 train.
alternatives.reason: No steps and a short walk, but the path is open to the sky and Gate A is the busiest exit.
alternatives.text_localised: 走河边开放步道到 A 门，再步行去车站，乘 23:27、6 号站台。
alternatives.reason_localised: 路面无台阶，但没有遮挡，A 门人最多。

alternatives.action: Use the canopy walk to Gate B and take the later 23:47 train.
alternatives.reason: Covered walk past the food trucks if your group is slow, but you wait for the 23:47 train.
alternatives.text_localised: 走有顶棚的 Canopy 步道经小吃车到 B 门，乘 23:47、6 号站台。
alternatives.reason_localised: 全程有遮挡，适合人多走得慢；但要等到 23:47。

alternatives.action: Go to Gate A and catch the 23:30 shuttle to Southern Cross instead.
alternatives.reason: Big shuttle with plenty of seats and a covered shelter, but it goes to Southern Cross, not your Sandringham train.
alternatives.text_localised: 从 A 门去 Batman Ave 候车亭，乘 23:30 班车到南十字星站。
alternatives.reason_localised: 座位多、候车亭有顶；但到的是南十字星站，不是你的线路。

SET_RIVER_30.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的咨询帐篷，或把此屏幕出示给任何志愿者。
SET_RIVER_30.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s3.2 Program changes (MOCK)

STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL.action: Leave now via Gate C on the covered path to Flinders Street
STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL.reason: This keeps your Sandringham train home: covered walk all the way, inside the station before the storm at 23:00. Gate A is closed, so Gate C is your covered way out.
STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL.text_localised: 现在从C门走有顶棚的通道去弗林德斯街车站，6号站台，22:52 的 Sandringham 线列车。
STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL.reason_localised: A门已关闭。全程有遮蔽，23:00 暴雨前你已在车站内。列车延误25分钟，22:52 发车。

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and the 22:50 general shuttle
alternatives.reason: Covered and step-free, but it goes to Southern Cross, not your Sandringham line — you must leave by 22:31.
alternatives.text_localised: 走有顶棚的坡道去D门，乘 22:50 的普通接驳车到南十字站。
alternatives.reason_localised: 全程有遮蔽，但终点是南十字站，不是你的 Sandringham 线。最迟 22:31 出发。

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and wait under shelter for the 23:30 shuttle
alternatives.reason: Use only if you miss the earlier options: the shuttle shelter is covered, but you wait through the storm.
alternatives.text_localised: 走坡道到D门，在有顶棚的接驳车候车棚等 23:30 的班车。
alternatives.reason_localised: 候车棚有顶，但要在暴雨中等待，且只到南十字站。

STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL.escalate_text_localised: 请前往最近的信息帐篷，或把这个屏幕出示给任何一位志愿者。
STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s4.2 Severe weather (MOCK), EMP s5.1 Gate closure (MOCK), EMP s6.3 Public transport disruption (MOCK), EMP s7.4 Accessible transport (MOCK)
